mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing hydrocodone metabolism and increasing opioid levels while also potentiating serotonergic and noradrenergic effects leading to serotonin syndrome, respiratory depression, and hypotensive crisis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, discontinue phenelzine for at least 14 days before initiating hydrocodone, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome, respiratory depression, and cardiovascular instability.
